points.methodology: Frozen end-block basket alpha quantities (large baskets >=100 holdings), historical spot prices and fast EMA; out-of-band holding contributions only, all incoming origins anchored. Spot valuation proxy, not a historical replay of realizable share mints. Missing anchors excluded, never counted as passing.
